description: This Python source file sets up an AI assistant bot that integrates multiple services including speech-to-text, text-to-speech, language model, and various external tool integrations. It defines an async main function to initialize the bot with different transport mechanisms, configures function schemas for weather and restaurant recommendations, and constructs a processing pipeline that manages user input, AI responses, and various handlers.

classes.name: Pipeline
classes.description: Represents the sequence of processing steps for handling user interactions.

classes.name: PipelineTask
classes.description: Defines a specific task with a processing pipeline and parameters.

classes.name: PipelineParams
classes.description: Configuration parameters for a pipeline task.

classes.name: FunctionSchema
classes.description: Schema describing a function accessible to the language model.

classes.name: ToolsSchema
classes.description: Schema aggregating multiple tool function schemas.

classes.name: LLMContext
classes.description: Holds conversation context and facilitates interaction with the language model.

classes.name: LLMContextAggregatorPair
classes.description: Holds paired aggregators for user and assistant, managing context and responses.

classes.name: LLMUserAggregatorParams
classes.description: Parameters configuring user response aggregation, including turn strategies.

classes.name: UserTurnStrategies
classes.description: Defines strategies for managing user turns in the conversation.

classes.name: TurnAnalyzerUserTurnStopStrategy
classes.description: Strategy to determine when to terminate user turns based on turn analysis.

classes.name: LocalSmartTurnAnalyzerV3
classes.description: Analyzes user turns locally to determine turn boundaries.

classes.name: PipelineRunner
classes.description: Manages execution and lifecycle of a processing pipeline.

methods.name: fetch_restaurant_recommendation(params: FunctionCallParams)

methods.name: run_bot(transport: BaseTransport, runner_args: RunnerArguments)
